 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. After a slow start for AC Milan in their Europa League clash with Bournemouth, matters went from bad to worse before half-time.
 Ruben Amorim's side were left stunned at the Vitality Stadium inside eight minutes as the hosts were awarded a penalty for a handball against Koni De Winter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Justin Kluivert calmly converted from the spot, but it didn't take Marco Rose's side very long to build on their advantage.
 Before half-time, Milan captain Mike Maignan was shown a straight red card for violent conduct after he appeared to shove his gloves in the face of Tyler Adams as a Bournemouth corner was being taken.
 The decision came after VAR intervention and this time it was Marcus Tavernier who stepped up to score the resulting penalty, giving Bournemouth a two-goal lead at the break.
 Omari Hutchinson made way so young goalkeeper Lorenzo Torriani could come on, but it's certainly a long way back for Milan now as the second half gets underway.
